name: Nicetas
troparia: (Tone 4) Taking up the Cross of Christ ardently, as it were a sword,* you made haste to do battle with the enemy,* and, suffering for Christ,* you at last committed your sacred soul to the Lord,* and hence you have been vouchsafed* to receive from Him gifts of healing, O great-martyr Nicetas.* Entreat Christ God that our souls be saved.
kontakia: (Tone 2) You crushed the power of error by your perseverance* and earned the crown of victory by your struggles.* Now you rejoice in the company of the angels in heaven,* O namesake of victory Nicetas,* and are praying Christ our God without ceasing for all of us.
